AddBodyShapeText.description: Adds a text to the body shape of the current notes page.

params.description: The text to be added to the body shape.
params.name: sText

returns.description: Returns true if text was added successfully, otherwise false.

GetBodyShape.description: Returns a shape with the type="body" attribute from the current notes page.

returns.description: The text from the body shape.

GetClassType.description: Returns the type of the ApiNotesPage class.

GetTheme.description: Returns a theme of the current notes page.

returns.description: Returns null if the notes page master or theme doesn't exist.
